quarterly_data.quarter: GlobalFoundries press release: GlobalFoundries and Marvell expand collaboration for (09-17-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: GF and Marvell announced an expanded multi-year agreement to increase capacity for GF's silicon germanium (SiGe) technology at its Burlington, Vermont facility, used in next-generation pluggable optical transceivers, Near-Packaged Optics (NPO) and Co-packaged Optics (CPO); the agreement builds on existing production and is expected to add significant capacity to support Marvell's growing requirements. GF says its current SiGe technology supports 200G-per-lane optical connectivity with a roadmap to higher-speed generations, and that it continues to co-integrate SiGe, silicon photonics and advanced packaging for NPO and CPO. No volume, dollar value or capacity figure stated.
quarterly_data.figure: multi-year agreement; current SiGe supports 200G-per-lane; no capacity or dollar figure stated

connects_to.relationship: SiGe foundry capacity (Burlington, Vermont) for Marvell optical connectivity products

contracts.source: GlobalFoundries press release: GlobalFoundries and Marvell expand collaboration for (09-17-2026)
contracts.signal: Expanded multi-year strategic agreement to increase capacity for GF's high-performance SiGe technology at Burlington, Vermont to support Marvell's growing requirements for next-generation optical connectivity (pluggable optical transceivers, NPO and CPO); it builds on existing production and more than a decade of GF-Marvell collaboration. Marvell VP Foundry Technology Robb Johnson: the expanded collaboration 'will help ensure we have the SiGe technology and manufacturing capacity to support the significant growth we see ahead.'
